bridge_consistency.contract: Bridge consistency compares each DOH-quarterly R10-scope observation to the nearest same-metric DOH-monthly or slide-anchor observation in the same calendar year. A pair is judged only against the comparator lineage's own observed adjacent normalized volatility; no external tolerance is hand set.

contract: R12-06 does not alter model predictions. It adjudicates whether the DOH-quarterly lineage that drove R12-04 can be used scientifically: first through 1y/2y lineage-only R11-28 checks under an explicitly relaxed diagnostic min-train window, then through bridge consistency against DOH-monthly and slide-anchor observations using only comparator-observed volatility as tolerance.
scientific_read: DOH-quarterly support can be evaluated at 1y/2y using a diagnostic minimum-train window, and R11-28 beats carry-forward on those short horizons. This supports using DOH quarterly as an adjudication source, but it remains too short for the production 3y/5y R10 claim gate.
